# Name Register

The social register of a name-usage (formal, intimate, professional, casual) — the naming specialization of the gmeow:Register umbrella (#355): a name register IS a register, so persona expression and name address draw from one vocabulary spine. A value vocabulary carried by gmeow:usageRegister on a gmeow:NameUsage.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NameRegister>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:NameRegister`  

**Subclass of:** `gmeow:Register`, `gufo:QualityValue`  

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/names>
